name: McLean County, IL
findings: McLean County has 677 nonprofit organizations. 335 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 267 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, McLean County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 health care organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list public events
observations.text: 9 hobby and sports organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 18 would.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in McLean County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 25 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
